svg.title: Plant Monitor v1 perfboard layout
svg.text: Plant Monitor v1 - perfboard layout 70 x 50 mm, top view (component side), to scale
Perfboard, TP4056, BH1750, AHT20 L x W measured by Arsany (A-093); SuperMini and all heights UNVERIFIED typical. Hole grid c1..c24 / r1..r18 counted from a photo.
flat on Kapton + tape, LEDs up
pad order UNVERIFIED (rotated 180 deg from photo 2): read the silk
Legend: yellow dot = hole used. Red hatched box = antenna keep-out: no wire, part, metal, battery or screw in it.
Wires run on the solder side; only W13 (blue) and W16 (green), routed around the keep-out, are drawn dashed; all others are straight (see the Route column).
Left short edge carries both USB-C ports (SuperMini y 11 mm, TP4056 y 41.5 mm, both UNVERIFIED). BOOT/RESET keys are behind the SuperMini USB-C end (need a pin-hole access).
Oval pads along both 50 mm edges are exposed copper: put Kapton under anything that overhangs them (TP4056, SuperMini USB-C).
